title: Final-retry Newton iteration-prefix tomography across G21H adjacent status boundaries
question: At the G21H smallest retry duration, at which nonlinear-iteration prefix do adjacent binary64 heads first diverge in backtracking/convergence behavior, and can that branch point be localized without modifying production HeadCalc or solver state?
experiment_contract: Add test-bridge/wrapper infrastructure only. Copy corrector_parameters and corrector_config for every isolated probe.
Set probe_config.transaction.max_retries=0 and probe_parameters.max_iterations to the requested prefix. Do not mutate the saved corrector objects.
Run the existing serialized-reference backend at the frozen final retry duration from a fresh immutable-origin checkpoint for every head and every prefix 1..16.
Read the existing backend observation after each probe and report solver status, nonlinear iterations, Jacobian builds, linear solves, cumulative backtracking attempts and internal retries.
Discard every raw candidate before returning. No participant/G16 candidate or publication authority may be created.

Use the production HeadCalc source only as a static semantic oracle: MaxIt1=MaxIt in the ordinary non-fldtmin route, the nonlinear loop is bounded by MaxIt1, and backtracking attempts are counted in the factor-reduction loop.
For each head, derive cumulative-backtracking increments from adjacent prefixes. Do not infer residual values that are not exposed by the qualified observation surface.
Verify prefix stability: once a status-0 arm converges, larger max_iterations must reproduce the same converged solver diagnostics rather than extend the trajectory.
Verify the prefix-16 observation reproduces G21H exactly for all four heads.

classification_rules.PREFIX_BACKTRACKING_BRANCH_LOCALIZED: Both boundaries reproduce the G21H final split and each has a finite first prefix at which the adjacent heads' cumulative backtracking counts diverge before or at the status-0 arm's first convergence.
classification_rules.PREFIX_CONVERGENCE_BRANCH_WITHOUT_PRIOR_: The final split and first convergence prefixes reproduce G21H, but adjacent cumulative backtracking counts remain identical through the status-0 convergence prefix.
classification_rules.PREFIX_FORENSICS_PARTIAL: The final G21H split reproduces but one or more prefix invariants are not sufficient to localize the branch.
classification_rules.PREFIX_PROBE_INVALID: Changing copied max_iterations changes earlier solver behavior inconsistently with prefix semantics or saved configuration/authority is mutated.

gates: All four heads and final-duration values match G21H exactly.
Sixteen isolated max-iteration prefixes are executed per head.
Prefix 16 reproduces G21H solver status, nonlinear-iteration count and cumulative backtracking count exactly.
B1 status-0 first convergence occurs at prefix 4; B2 status-0 first convergence occurs at prefix 3.
Both status-6 heads remain nonconverged through prefix 16.
Nonlinear iterations never exceed the requested prefix and equal the prefix for every nonconverged probe.
After status-0 first convergence, all larger prefixes are diagnostically stable.
Saved corrector parameters/configuration, accepted revision/time/ledger and participant/G16 liveness remain unchanged.
pass_interpretation: PASS qualifies only localization of the final-retry nonlinear-solver branch using iteration-prefix evidence. It does not change solver tolerances, HeadCalc behavior, participant acceptance, retry policy, response-space globalization, or production HCOF/RHS.
fail_interpretation: Preserve the failure. Do not add a production trace hook, alter solver limits, snap heads, or weaken G21H/G21G evidence to force a clean prefix interpretation.
